'''CZ-3T6''', or '''3T''', was a [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]] who worked in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], 3T was reassigned to the [[Imeici Spire]].
